decisions.reason: As a close-to-core biodynamic yogurt that remained listed through 2024 in a growing market, it likely has low carrying cost and enough fit with the firm's organic dairy range to justify keeping the option open.
This mild sliced cheese is a very recent, adjacent launch in the firm's established cheese business, so uncertainty is still resolving and the cost of continuing it for another year is likely modest.

The sliced butter cheese is also a new, close-to-core extension worth keeping while demand information accumulates, though its overlap with other sliced cheese offerings makes pruning somewhat more likely than for the others.
